annotations.exact_quote: Hierarchical multi-label prediction of gene function
annotations.reason_zh: 标题直接表明是多标记预测任务，即为单个基因预测多个功能标记。

annotations.exact_quote: Using a hierarchy of support vector machine (SVM) classifiers trained on multiple data types, we combined predictions in our Bayesian framework
annotations.reason_zh: 结合多个SVM分类器的预测以获得一致功能预测，属于分类器集成。

annotations.exact_quote: we combined predictions in our Bayesian framework to obtain the most probable consistent set of predictions
annotations.reason_zh: 使用贝叶斯框架融合预测并求最可能一致预测集，进行后验推断。

annotations.exact_quote: Taking the hierarchical structure into account resolves such inconsistencies
annotations.reason_zh: 显式利用功能类层次结构（父子依赖）解决不一致预测，建模标签间层级相关结构。

annotations.exact_quote: our method also provides implicit calibration of SVM margin outputs to probabilities
annotations.reason_zh: 方法将SVM margin输出隐式校准为概率，使置信度与正确概率相符。

abstentions.reason_zh: 摘要仅提及使用多种数据类型训练SVM，未说明是否显式联合利用多个视图间关系，可能只是特征拼接，定义不满足。
